## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`docs/git-workflow/commit-convention.md`) (`<type>[optional scope]: <description>`).
- [ ] Branch name follows the branching strategy (`docs/git-workflow/branching-strategy.md`) (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, ...).
- [ ] Exactly one worklog file `docs/worklog/YYYY-MM-DD-<branch-slug>.md` is included and committed.
- [ ] PR description matches the worklog body.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data (no individual names in the worklog).
- [ ] Documentation and code comments are in English.
